name: Lark Bot Bridge
description: Bridge a Feishu/Lark self-built bot over persistent WebSocket to your local Orca Bot.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Lark Bot Bridge status (click to reconnect)

commands.title: Lark Bot: Generate Owner Pairing Code

settings.title: Feishu App ID
settings.description: Self-built app ID from Feishu/Lark Open Platform (e.g. cli_xxxx).

settings.title: Feishu Open API Domain
settings.description: Feishu CN or international Lark Open API base domain.

settings.title: Target Orca Bot
settings.description: Local Orca Bot name that receives Feishu requests (for example: MyBot).

settings.title: Orca Bot Webhook URL
settings.description: Default Webhook URL copied from the target Bot's webhook.call automation card in Orca.

settings.title: Additional Bot Routes
settings.description: Optional /<BotName> routes for multi-bot dispatch, one per line as BotName=WebhookURL (or JSON {"BotName":"WebhookURL"}). URLs are never logged or shown in plaintext.

settings.title: Allowed Group Chat IDs
settings.description: Comma or newline separated opt-in Feishu group chat_ids where @bot /<BotName> is enabled.

settings.title: Feishu Transport Mode
settings.description: Use @larksuiteoapi/node-sdk when installed or the built-in zero-dependency WebSocket client.
enumLabels: Auto (Node SDK if installed, else built-in WS)

settings.title: Local Callback Port
settings.description: Loopback port on 127.0.0.1 for Bot MCP callbacks (0 picks an ephemeral port automatically).

settings.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Seconds before marking an unanswered Bot request as timed out and updating the Feishu card (default 600 = 10 minutes).

settings.title: Auto Connect on Startup
settings.description: Automatically start the Feishu persistent WebSocket connection when credentials are present.
